failure_cases.must_fail_when: Chinese generic continuation is classified as approval.
English generic go-ahead language is classified as approval.
A paraphrase is classified as exact approval.
A partial phrase is classified as exact approval.
A phrase with a wrong status-change count is classified as approval.
A phrase missing commit/push/sync prohibitions is classified as approval.
A phrase adding merge/mainline authority is classified as approval.
Whitespace or case normalization changes are ignored and classified as approval.
This slice treats a fixture pass as user approval collected now.
